response.sql: WITH per_station AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg_usage) AS avg_band_usage_pct, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(telescope_count) / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM per_station) AS share_of_total FROM per_station GROUP BY lunarstage;
